faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICMR NIHR Project Research Scientist-II (Non- Medical) position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 16th August 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Public Health, Epidemiology, or Population Sciences. This can be with three years of post-qualification experience or a PhD in the relevant subject.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Research Scientist-II (Non- Medical) role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided to eligible categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How will the candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in-interview or a Written Test, followed by a Skill Test where applicable. Candidates are advised to prepare thoroughly for these stages.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist-II (Non- Medical) post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 67,000/- per month, along with House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. Is this a permanent or temporary job?
faq.answer: The job offered is temporary in nature. This is a project-based recruitment, and the duration of employment will be as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q7. How should I submit my application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted via email. You must send your duly completed application form along with self-attested copies of relevant documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of your educational qualifications, experience certificates, publications (if any), and a recent passport-size photograph with your application.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official websites: http://niirncd.icmr.org.in or https://www.icmr.gov.in. The official notification will also be available on these sites.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the National Institute of Health Research Jodhpur, located in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, with the pincode 342005.
